2025-05-01.riddle: I spin without getting dizzy, point without a finger, and always know the way, no matter where I am. What am I?
2025-05-01.hint: I can be used for navigation.

2025-05-02.riddle: I hold things together, but I’m not a hand. You’ll find me on papers, or in a desk stand. What am I?
2025-05-02.hint: I fasten papers with a metallic bite.

2025-05-03.riddle: I come in pieces, but I form a whole. Fit me together, and reach your goal. What am I?
2025-05-03.hint: Many pieces, one picture — fit them just right.

2025-05-04.riddle: I go up and down, but never move. You step on me, but I don’t bruise. What am I?
2025-05-04.hint: You use me to climb, but I stay in place.

2025-05-05.riddle: I wave but have no hand, I crash but never land. I’m salty, deep, and never still— What am I?
2025-05-05.hint: I cover most of Earth, move in tides, and touch every shore.

2025-05-06.riddle: I’m black and white and read all over, Sometimes folded, sometimes spread like a cover. I bring you stories of world and town— What am I?
2025-05-06.hint: I deliver daily headlines, but you can’t watch me—I’m meant to be read.
